content.summary: View TIFF image stacks with gallery and thumbnail modes. Browse individual slices, zoom, pan, and quickly navigate through your data.
content.body:
The Image Viewer module provides a comprehensive interface for viewing TIFF image stacks commonly used in biomedical imaging.

Key Features:
• Gallery Mode: View individual slices in full-size with zoom and pan controls
• Thumbnail Mode: See an overview grid of all slices for quick navigation
• Zoom & Pan: Use mouse wheel to zoom and drag to pan when zoomed in
• Slice Navigation: Use slider, buttons, or keyboard to navigate between slices
• Integration: View results from segmentation and denoising modules directly

Supported File Formats:
The viewer supports multi-page TIFF files (.tif, .tiff), which are the standard format for microscopy image stacks. Both 8-bit and 16-bit images are supported, with automatic contrast adjustment for optimal viewing.

Workflow:
1. Select Image: Choose a TIFF stack from your workspace or recent results
2. View Image: Browse through slices using gallery or thumbnail mode

content.summary: Select the TIFF image stack you want to view. Choose from workspace files or results from other processing modules.
content.body:
Data Sources:
• Workspace Files: TIFF stacks uploaded to your workspace
• Segmentation Results: View output from U-Net segmentation inference
• Denoising Results: View output from N2V or filter-based denoising

File Requirements:
• Format: Multi-page TIFF (.tif, .tiff)
• Bit Depth: 8-bit or 16-bit grayscale
• Dimensions: Any size (large files may load slower)
• Channels: Single channel (grayscale)

Validation:
When you select a file, the system validates it and displays information about the image dimensions, number of slices, and data type. This helps confirm you've selected the correct file before viewing.

content.summary: The viewer provides two modes for exploring your image stack: Gallery mode for detailed inspection and Thumbnail mode for quick overview.
content.body:
Gallery Mode:
Gallery mode displays a single slice at full resolution with zoom and pan capabilities.

• Navigation Buttons: Use Previous/Next buttons to move between slices
• Slice Slider: Drag the slider to quickly jump to any slice
• Zoom Controls: Use +/- buttons or mouse wheel to zoom in/out
• Pan: When zoomed in, click and drag to pan around the image
• Reset: Click Reset to return to 100% zoom and centered position

Thumbnail Mode:
Thumbnail mode displays all slices as a grid of small previews. This is useful for:
• Getting an overview of the entire stack
• Quickly finding slices of interest
• Comparing different regions across slices

Click any thumbnail to switch to Gallery mode for that slice.

File Info Display:
The toolbar shows the current filename and total slice count for reference. The slice indicator shows your current position (e.g., "25/100" means you're viewing slice 25 of 100).

tiff.definition: Tagged Image File Format - a flexible image format commonly used in microscopy for storing multi-page image stacks

slice.definition: A single 2D image within a 3D image stack, typically representing one focal plane or time point

stack.definition: A series of 2D images stored together, representing a 3D volume or time series

zoom.definition: Magnification level for viewing images - values above 100% show enlarged detail, below 100% shows a wider view

pan.definition: Moving the viewing area across a zoomed image by clicking and dragging
